name: live-research
description: Verify material facts that may have changed using current authoritative evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Verify changing facts against current sources.
interface.longDescription: Research change-sensitive claims with current primary sources, local environment evidence, release history, and dated citations. Separate verified facts, interpretations, conflicts, and gaps.
defaultPrompt: Use $live-research to verify the current facts and cite the authoritative sources.
